notes.inq-0035: Deliberately ambiguous. Reference label is 'permit' because the action the sender needs is a permit swap or refund, but 'conditions' is a defensible second label: the message hinges on whether the Avalanche Lake bridge washout makes the itinerary doable. A production system with an 'unsure' route should send this one to a human rather than pick confidently.
notes.inq-0013: Emergency: overdue hiker (husband, Highline Trail). Missing this one fails the lab regardless of overall accuracy.
notes.inq-0041: Emergency: injured hiker mid-trail (ankle, Beehive descent). Missing this one fails the lab regardless of overall accuracy.
